# P3-DESIGN — Interview / Manifest / Render / Command Integration

> **Status:** Phase-3 integration review (cross-check artifact).
> **Role:** Integration-lead consistency gate over four frozen/near-frozen P3 artifacts: the manifest schema, the question bank, the render-engine contract, and the `/ack-init` command. This document records what was verified end-to-end, the producer/consumer contract that P5 (gate) and P6 (telemetry) inherit, and the remaining inconsistencies as an actionable checklist.

---

## 1. Overview

`ai-core-kit` forks into a CHILD project. The CHILD's behavior is driven entirely by a single artifact, `project.manifest.yaml`, which is **produced by exactly one writer** (the `/ack-init` interview) and **consumed read-only** by three downstream layers (P4 renderer, P5 contract gate, P6 telemetry aggregator). The four P3 artifacts under review form a closed contract:

| Artifact | Path | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Frozen schema | `templates/manifest/project.manifest.schema.yaml` (+ generated `…schema.json`) | The FROZEN contract. Single source of truth for shape. |
| Question bank | `templates/interview/questions.yaml` | The deterministic interview that WRITES `managed:`. |
| Render-engine contract | `docs/RENDER-ENGINE.md` | The P4 renderer contract that READS `managed:`. |
| Init command | `.claude/commands/ack-init.md` | The orchestrator: archetype-first interview → validate → render → wire. |

The integration is sound on its three core guarantees, which were verified directly:

- **(a) Every question writes to a real schema path.** All 39 questions carry a `writes_to`; the 33 distinct targets each resolve to a property declared under `managed:` in the frozen schema. **Zero orphan keys** (invariant I1).
- **(b) The render engine reads only schema fields.** Every render input (`${dotted.path}`, `.when` guards, `#ack:each` lists) resolves against `managed:`; an absent key is `false`/omit (conditional) or a hard render error (substitution). No render input reaches outside the schema except optional `user.overrides.*`.
- **(c) The command flow produces a manifest P5 and P6 can consume.** `/ack-init` writes `contract_gate.*` + `contracts[]` (P5's inputs) and `telemetry.*` (P6's inputs), validates against the schema before any render, and writes the `rendered_files[]` ownership ledger that makes re-runs authoritative.
- **(d) Re-entrancy + meta-guard are coherent end-to-end.** Idempotency is STRUCTURAL (managed/user split + `manifest_hash` no-op fast path + ledger-gated managed-block merge), and the meta-repo guard fail-closes before any write. These line up across all four artifacts.

A small set of **inconsistencies remains** (Section 8) — none are blocking for the frozen schema, but several must be closed before P4/P5/P6 are runnable, and one (`contracts[]` required-but-unwritten for backend-api) is a real round-trip gap.

### Repository reality at review time

The frozen schema, `docs/RENDER-ENGINE.md`, and `.claude/commands/ack-init.md` are reviewed here **as supplied contracts but are not yet committed to disk**; only `templates/interview/questions.yaml` and `docs/BOOTSTRAP.md` exist in the tree. `templates/manifest/`, `templates/archetypes/`, and `.claude/commands/` are absent. This is consistent with the artifacts' own "OPEN QUESTIONS" (the JSON-Schema validator and the archetype template trees are not yet authored), but it means the author-time guards (schema validation, `writes_to` cross-check, meta-repo sentinels) cannot actually fire yet. See checklist items O1, O8.

## 2. The frozen schema (path)

**`templates/manifest/project.manifest.schema.yaml`** (schema_version 2), with its generated validator companion **`templates/manifest/project.manifest.schema.json`** (JSON-Schema draft 2020-12, `additionalProperties:false` everywhere).

Top-level envelope: `schema_version` (const 2) · `generator` (provenance, OUTSIDE the hash) · `managed:` (machine-owned, regenerated wholesale) · `user:` (human-owned, seeded once). Governing invariants relied on by this integration:

- **I1** every `writes_to` must resolve to a declared property (fail-closed at author time);
- **I2** idempotency is structural (managed/user split, no 3-way merge);
- **I3** `archetype` is the branch axis;
- **I4** `contract_gate.protected_paths` `minItems:1` — the gate is never vacuous; per-archetype questioning is deterministic;
- **I5** `additionalProperties:false` — a typo is a hard error;
- **I6** runtime fail-open / author-time fail-closed;
- **I7** forkability — meta engine never copied; child paths use `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}`.

## 3. Question-bank summary + branch matrix

`templates/interview/questions.yaml` — **39 questions, 39 `writes_to`**, archetype asked first and mandatory. Verified: all ids unique; archetype is `questions[0]`; `ask_if`/`skip_if` reference only earlier ids; no question carries both; every `writes_to` resolves to a schema `managed.*` property (I1 holds).

**Key branch differences confirmed coherent with the schema's per-archetype `if/then`:**

- **framework enum is archetype-scoped** via two mutually-exclusive questions (`framework_backend` `fastapi|express|nestjs|gin|axum` vs `framework_fullstack` `next|remix|sveltekit|nuxt`), exactly one of which fires. Matches schema prose.
- **design_system** is `applies_to:[fullstack]` only, so it is **structurally unwriteable** for backend-api — this satisfies the schema's `backend-api ⟹ properties.design_system:false` branch by construction (not by runtime check). Good.
- **persistence** is `applies_to:[backend-api,fullstack]`; infra-iac etc. never see a DB question (deterministic-interview guarantee, I4 / finding 4). Good.
- **protected_paths defaults differ per archetype** (backend `src/** migrations/** openapi/**`; fullstack `app/** api/** src/** prisma/schema.prisma`), each non-empty, satisfying I4 / `minItems:1`. Good.

> **Round-trip gap (see O3) — RESOLVED in schema_version 2:** schema_version 1 required `contracts[]` for backend-api (`backend-api ⟹ required:[contracts]`) while **no question writes `contracts[]`**, so an interview-only backend-api manifest failed schema validation. In schema_version 2 `contracts[]` is **optional with default `[]` for all archetypes**, so this round-trips cleanly with no seeded stub required.

## 4. Render-engine decision

**Decision (frozen in `docs/RENDER-ENGINE.md`): a tiny in-house `${VAR}` substitution renderer + a manifest-driven conditional/idempotency layer.** Copier and cookiecutter are explicitly rejected because they force a Python toolchain onto every child fork, breaking the `npx`/fork distribution story; copier's only unique feature (`copier update` 3-way re-render) is unneeded because idempotency here is **structural** (managed/user split + ownership ledger), per invariant I2.

Three strictly-separated responsibilities:

1. **Substitution** — `${dotted.path}` resolved against `managed:` (scalars only; unbound or container-valued ⟹ hard render error, the render-time mirror of I5).
2. **Conditional inclusion** — decided by the manifest, never by in-template `{% if %}`: path-segment `_when.<bool.path>/` directories (precedence) + a per-archetype `render.map.yaml` of glob→`when` guards. An absent `managed:` key ⟹ `when` false ⟹ file omitted (this is why design-system renders only for fullstack, with no special-casing).
3. **Idempotency** — `rendered_files[]` ownership ledger + `ack:managed` delimited blocks for shared files + whole-file ownership only when `managed_block:null`, plus a `manifest_hash` no-op fast path.

**Consumer-discipline confirmed (b):** render inputs are read only from `managed:` (`project.*`, `archetype`, `persistence.*`, `contract_gate.*`, `contracts[]`, `ci_cd.target`, …), with `user.overrides.*` optional and never required. The renderer never writes the manifest. Path hygiene (I7) is enforced: child files reference child artifacts via `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}` (upper-case, deliberately NOT matched by the lower-case substitution regex), and a render-time assertion aborts on any `templates/archetypes/` or absolute-ack-path substring in output.

> **Regex/key mismatch (see O4):** the substitution regex `\$\{([a-z0-9_]+(?:\.[a-z0-9_]+)*)\}` permits only `[a-z0-9_]` per segment, but the schema's `design_system.tokens` example keys use **hyphens** (`color-brand`, `radius-base`) and §4.3 of the render spec itself writes `${design_system.tokens.color-brand}`. That placeholder would not fully match the regex, so the token would not substitute. Either the regex must allow `-`, or token keys must be `snake_case`.

## 5. `/ack-init` flow diagram (text)

```
/ack-init  (in a FORKED CHILD repo; allowed-tools scoped; disable-model-invocation:true)
│
├─ STEP 0  META-REPO GUARD  (fail-closed, no override)
│     sentinel: templates/archetypes/  OR  docs/BOOTSTRAP.md present?
│        ── PRESENT ─▶ STOP. write nothing. print refusal. end turn.
│        ── absent ──▶ continue
│
├─ STEP 1  MODE + RE-ENTRANCY
│     --non-interactive ⟹ QA mode (requires --answers; no AskUserQuestion)
│     probe project.manifest.yaml:
│        PRESENT ⟹ RE-RUN  → read rendered_files[] ledger (authoritative owner list)
│                            carry user: subtree verbatim
│        absent  ⟹ FIRST RUN → will seed user: once
│
├─ STEP 2  FREEZE CONTRACT + ASK ARCHETYPE FIRST            ── I1, I3
│     author-time cross-check: every questions.yaml writes_to resolves in schema
│        ── orphan ─▶ HARD REFUSE "interview/manifest divergence"
│     archetype from --archetype | existing managed.archetype | AskUserQuestion | answers
│
├─ STEP 3  LOAD ARCHETYPE'S QUESTION SUBSET                 ── I4 (deterministic)
│     select questions where applies_to ∋ archetype; never present others
│        backend-api/fullstack = deep set ; monorepo/library-sdk/infra-iac = core only
│
├─ STEP 4  RUN INTERVIEW → ASSEMBLE managed:                ── ONLY WRITER
│     write each answer to its writes_to ; emit keys in schema order ; no timestamps
│     apply per-archetype rules:  fullstack⟹design_system required
│                                 backend-api⟹design_system omitted (contracts optional, default [] in v2)
│                                 always⟹protected_paths minItems 1
│     seed user: once (first run) / carry verbatim (re-run)
│     ┌─ VALIDATE against project.manifest.schema.json     ── I6 author-time fail-closed
│     │     invalid ─▶ ABORT, write NOTHING
│     └─ valid ─▶ compute manifest_hash LAST (sha256 of canonical managed: minus hash, minus generator.*)
│     idempotency short-circuit: recomputed hash == stored AND ledger paths unchanged
│        ─▶ print "nothing to do", exit 0, zero writes
│
├─ STEP 5  RENDER (P4 engine)                               ── reads managed: only ; I7 paths
│     walk templates/archetypes/<archetype>/ ; ${VAR} substitute ; .when select
│
├─ STEP 6  WIRE INTEGRATIONS per features.* (managed-block MERGE)
│     sdd_gate⟹install .claude/hooks/contract-gate (managed_block:null)
│              + register matcher Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit in settings.json ack:managed block
│     mcp⟹.mcp.json ack:managed ; agent_teams⟹env in settings ; telemetry⟹offline attribution ; discovery⟹child opt-in only
│     conflict policy: default/--skip = keep existing (CI-safe) ; --force = overwrite managed region only
│
└─ STEP 7  EMIT minimal child CLAUDE.md (ack:managed pointer) + FINALIZE
      update managed.rendered_files[] (every path + managed_block|null) ── next-run authority
      print summary (archetype, written/merged/skipped, gate mode, first-run|re-run)
```

## 6. Producer / Consumer contract table

One producer, three consumers; none of the consumers ever writes the manifest.

| Manifest region | Producer | Consumer(s) | Contract / consumption rule | Verified |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | /ack-init | P4, P5, P6 | const 2; major-version mismatch ⟹ gate→off+stderr, aggregator→error | ✓ |
| `generator.*` | /ack-init | (none, provenance) | EXCLUDED from `manifest_hash`; keeps re-runs byte-stable | ✓ |
| `managed.manifest_hash` | /ack-init (written LAST) | /ack-init re-run | sha256 of canonical `managed:` minus hash & generator; no-op fast path | ✓ |
| `managed.project.*` | /ack-init interview | **P4** | `${project.*}` render vars; framework enum archetype-scoped | ✓ |
| `managed.archetype` | /ack-init (Q0) | **P4** | branch axis: selects template tree + `.when` resolution (I3) | ✓ |
| `managed.features.*` | /ack-init interview | **P4** | toggles which blocks render; `sdd_gate` master-switches the gate | ✓ |
| `managed.api_first` | /ack-init interview | **P4** | scaffolds API spec stub / API surface in protected_paths | ✓ |
| `managed.persistence.*` | /ack-init interview | **P4** | `enabled:false` ⟹ persistence scaffold omitted | ✓ |
| `managed.contract_gate.{mode,glob_dialect,protected_paths,scope,exempt}` | /ack-init interview | **P5** hook | hook reads THIS (never hardcoded defaults); exempt > scope/protected; unmatched ⟹ allow; block=exit2+deny, warn=exit0+stderr, off=exit0 silent; FAIL-OPEN if manifest missing | ✓ |
| `managed.contract_gate.require_approval_by` | /ack-init interview | review tooling (advisory) | NOT enforced by hook | ✓ |
| `managed.contracts[]` | **ack (NOT the interview)** | **P5** (approved-oracle), P4 (stub scaffold) | edit under scope allowed iff a covering contract has `status:approved`; optional (default `[]`) for all archetypes in schema_version 2 | ✓ (O3 resolved in v2) |
| `managed.design_system.*` | /ack-init interview (fullstack only) | **P4** | required fullstack / forbidden backend-api; `install:true` ⟹ copy Apache-2.0 skills + NOTICE | ✓ |
| `managed.telemetry.{enabled,attribution.*,pricing_ref,budgets[]}` | /ack-init interview (+ ack seeds `budgets[]`) | **P6** aggregator (OFFLINE) | no live cost; buckets `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl × pricing.json`; budgets advisory (flag, never enforce); fails loud on unknown model | ✓ |
| `managed.discovery.enabled` | /ack-init interview | child opt-in surface | default OFF; meta engine never copied (I7) | ✓ |
| `managed.ci_cd.target` | /ack-init interview | **P4** | selects CI workflow template | ✓ |
| `managed.rendered_files[]` | **P4** (written back), /ack-init STEP 7 | /ack-init re-run, P4 | ownership ledger; anything absent = user territory, never touched | ✓ |
| `user.*` | /ack-init (seeded ONCE) | P4 reads `user.overrides.*` only (optional) | never overwritten after first run (I2) | ✓ |

**P5 (gate) consumability:** all inputs the hook contract names — `mode`, `glob_dialect`, `protected_paths`, `scope`, `exempt`, and the `contracts[]` approved-oracle — are present in `managed:` and produced by the flow. Consumable; O3 is resolved in schema_version 2 (`contracts[]` is optional with default `[]`, so no backend-api seed is required for the manifest to validate).

**P6 (telemetry) consumability:** `telemetry.enabled/attribution.*/pricing_ref` are all interview-written; `budgets[]` is ack-seeded. The aggregator's only hard external dependency is `telemetry/pricing.json`, which is a path reference, not manifest data. Consumable.

## 7. Re-entrancy + meta-guard coherence (end-to-end)

Confirmed coherent across all four artifacts:

- **Meta-guard:** `/ack-init` STEP 0 fail-closes on `templates/archetypes/` OR `docs/BOOTSTRAP.md`; the renderer independently refuses to copy the meta `.claude/` tree (I7); `discovery.enabled` defaults OFF. Three layers agree the meta engine never reaches a child. (Note: `docs/BOOTSTRAP.md` exists in THIS repo, so the command correctly refuses to run in place — it is authored here but executes only in a fork.)
- **Structural idempotency (I2):** managed/user split + `manifest_hash` no-op fast path + `rendered_files[]` ledger + `ack:managed` block merge. The command (STEP 1/4/6/7), the schema (`manifest_hash`, `rendered_files`, managed/user), and the render spec (§5) describe the same mechanism with the same field names. No 3-way merge anywhere.
- **Fail-open / fail-closed split (I6):** author/write time (schema validation, `writes_to` cross-check, meta-guard) is fail-closed (abort, write nothing); consume time (gate with a missing/garbled manifest) is fail-open (degrade to `off` + stderr). Schema, gate contract, and command all state this identically.
- **Hook matcher / runtime:** `Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit`, `python3`, `fnmatch` with `**` — identical in schema, command STEP 6, and render spec §7.3.

## 8. Open issues — TODO checklist

Author-time blockers and round-trip gaps to close before P4/P5/P6 are runnable. None require changing the FROZEN schema except where noted.

- [ ] **O1 — Generate the JSON-Schema validator.** `templates/manifest/project.manifest.schema.json` does not exist on disk; neither does the `…schema.yaml`. STEP 4 validation and the I1 `writes_to` cross-check cannot fire until both are authored. The JSON file must mirror the YAML contract exactly (`additionalProperties:false` everywhere, the `allOf`/`if-then` per-archetype blocks, glob/contract/telemetry `$defs`).
- [ ] **O2 — Decide who seeds the non-interview structures.** `contracts[]`, `telemetry.budgets[]`, `design_system.tokens` have schema properties but **no question**. Document explicitly (in the command spec) that ack seeds these (empty/defaults), or add a structured-entry question type. Currently only implied.
- [x] **O3 — Resolve the `contracts[]` required-but-unwritten gap (round-trip break). RESOLVED in schema_version 2.** The on-disk schema took the second option: backend-api no longer `required:[contracts]` — `contracts[]` is now **optional with default `[]` for all archetypes**, so an interview-only backend-api manifest validates without a seeded stub. (Original gap: schema_version 1 required `contracts[]` for backend-api, but no `writes_to` targeted it, so an interview-only backend-api manifest failed schema validation.)
- [ ] **O4 — Fix substitution regex vs hyphenated token keys.** The render regex `[a-z0-9_]` cannot match `${design_system.tokens.color-brand}` used in render spec §4.3 (and the schema's example token keys `color-brand`, `radius-base`). Either widen the regex segment class to include `-`, or constrain token keys to `snake_case`. Decide and make schema example + render spec consistent.
- [ ] **O5 — Unify managed-block markers for comment-less file types.** The command illustrates `# >>> ack:managed` comment markers, but JSON files (`settings.json`, `.mcp.json`) have no comments. The render spec §5.2 sketches a JSON parse+replace-managed-keys merge instead. Enumerate the exact "managed keys" set per JSON file jointly between the render and gate teams (render-spec open Q3).
- [ ] **O6 — Pick ONE conditional-inclusion mechanism (or formalize precedence).** Render spec ships BOTH path-segment `_when.*` and `render.map.yaml`. Confirm the stated precedence (path-segment wins) and the `requires_archetype` belt-and-suspenders guard, or drop one to reduce surface area (render-spec open Q1).
- [ ] **O7 — Specify `manifest_hash` canonicalization ONCE.** Key order (= schema order), exclusion of `generator.*` and the hash field, and YAML/JSON canonical form must be defined in one place and reused by both the renderer and `/ack-init` re-run, or re-runs will not be byte-stable (schema open Q4). Also reconcile the hashing tool: the command's `allowed-tools` lists `sha256sum`/`shasum` but not a canonicalizer.
- [ ] **O8 — Author the archetype template trees + `render.map.yaml`.** `templates/archetypes/<archetype>/` does not exist. The branch matrix and render decision are untestable until at least `backend-api` and `fullstack` trees (and their `render.map.yaml`) exist. Acceptance tests T1–T6 (render spec §8) depend on this.
- [ ] **O9 — Commit `ack-init.md` and `RENDER-ENGINE.md` to disk.** Both are reviewed as contracts but absent from the tree (`.claude/commands/` has no `ack-init.md`). Without them the command cannot be invoked and the render contract cannot be cited.
- [ ] **O10 — Confirm unknown-sentinel expression semantics in `/ack-init`.** The bank's cascade (`migrations_tool`/`migrations_dir` `ask_if migrations_enabled==true`, where `migrations_enabled` itself depends on `persistence_enabled`) relies on a skipped id evaluating to the unknown sentinel so `==`/`in` are false. STEP 3/4 must implement this exactly as the questions.yaml header documents (questions-bank open Q1).
- [ ] **O11 — `framework` enum enforcement (advisory).** The enum is archetype-scoped in prose; JSON-Schema can enforce it only via per-archetype `if/then` or leave it a free string with interview-side validation. Schema open Q3 recommends interview-side; if so, document that the schema deliberately does NOT enforce the framework enum.
- [ ] **O12 — `tool_version` provenance source.** `generator.tool_version` is "this kit's version" — wire it to a real build-time version source so it is reproducible (command open Q4). (Behaviorally harmless: it is outside `manifest_hash`.)
